assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Create a faithful clean studio packshot of the EXACT closed 500g Osem three-color baked couscous/ptitim bag in this photo. Remove crate, clothing and background. Straight upright front view on pure white with subtle contact shadow; entire sealed bag visible, retain actual wide/height proportions, orange/red checked lower wrapper, transparent upper window filled with small ivory/green/orange round dry pasta pearls. Preserve exact original Osem Hebrew logo and Hebrew text 'פתיתים אפויים', 'קוסקוס 3 צבעים', 8 minute clock and 500 גרם weight, small original certification printed on the lower left. Do NOT add new certification names, translate or redesign the package, do NOT turn pearls into different pasta. Remove visible dates/lot codes only. Keep gentle realistic plastic folds and food texture, no added props or claims.
